_role: READ-ONLY continuous dual-venue executable shadow. For every L5 action it observes, it evaluates Polymarket and Gemini through ONE ladder evaluator and records the router's PMUS / GEMINI / BOTH / NEITHER decision with its reason. It produces evidence, never orders.
_credentials: NONE. No exchange key, no wallet key, no PMUS_SPRING_* / KALSHI_* / POLYMARKET_* secret. Every call is an unauthenticated GET to a public endpoint (gamma-api, clob, data-api, api.gemini.com). If a value ever appears necessary here, that is a signal to stop, not to add one.
_volume: Mount a dedicated volume at /state/l5-exec-shadow. Do NOT reuse /state/l5-fidelity (the prediction store), /state/pmus-spring (the executor) or /data/l5_shadow (the older loop). Pending maker quotes are rebuilt from this volume's own log on boot, so the volume IS the recovery mechanism.
_pin: Set RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH=/deploy/l5_exec_shadow/Dockerfile on the service (deploy/RAILWAY_ISOLATION.md pattern) so a branch push cannot cross-build it.
_promotion: watchPatterns point ONLY at deploy/_promote/l5-exec-shadow. Editing source does not deploy this service; appending a promote line to that sentinel does. See deploy/_promote/README.md.
_restart_note: ALWAYS, because this is a read-only recorder: a crash must not end the observation series, and there is no money-moving state that a restart could compound. The money-moving probe uses the opposite policy on purpose.
_not_yet_created: As of the commit that adds this file the Railway service does NOT exist. Creating it costs money and is the owner's call; everything needed to stand it up in one deliberate act is here.
